# Xingtai Hengtuo Transmission Technology Co., Ltd.

> Precision bearing manufacturer and supplier. Medium and small bearings only — outer diameter up to 600 mm. Minimum order 50 pieces. Precision classes P0/P6/P5. Custom bearings available on inquiry.
